operators.name: stack_forward
semantics: Stacks x1 and x2 along a new first dimension, resulting in shape [2, 512, 3, 512, 512].
The first element along the new dimension is x1, the second is x2; no reordering.
Output is on CUDA, float32, contiguous.
Equivalent to torch.stack([x1, x2]) with default dim=0.
